summary.text: Justin Cochran, a Democrat, represents Illinois's 55th House District.

paragraphs.text: According to the General Assembly biography, he has lived in Des Plaines since 1997 and graduated from Maine West High School.

The biography says he earned bachelor's and master's degrees in history and political science from Northeastern Illinois University, worked as an archivist with the Illinois State Archives, and served as chief of staff to State Representative Marty Moylan.
